title: fix(runtime,cli): /ready reports the boot seed, and os serve prints the seed result its banner promised
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D4Jsmd91BqTVB7dSii9uJMV)_

Fixes #33233

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:`GET /api/v1/ready` 的 200 响应在应用声明了种子数据时多带一个 `seed` 字段(`pending` / `settled` / `failed`);`os serve` / `os dev` 的启动横幅若写了"种子仍在写入、结果会在横幅之后打印",种子落定时现在真的会打印一行结果。
- **为什么改**:种子超出内联预算后在后台继续写,`/ready` 却一直答 ready;落定信号只走 `os dev` 的 IPC,另一个进程(演示脚本、e2e、云健康检查)无从得知种子何时写完,下游应用因此在半成品数据上下单算错。横幅承诺的结果在默认日志级别下也从不出现。
- **风险与回滚**:纯增量。状态码不变(种子写入期间仍是 200,不会把副本摘出负载均衡);没有种子数据的应用 `/ready` 响应体与之前逐字节相同。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**:① `packages/runtime/src/seed-readiness.ts`(`failed` 的判据,与 IPC 消息的 `ok` 同口径);② `packages/runtime/src/http-dispatcher.ts` 的 `/ready` 两个 200 分支;③ `packages/cli/src/utils/seed-result-after-banner.ts` 及其在 `packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts` 的接线(只在横幅说过 pending 时打印,且只打印一次)。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm dev:showcase -- --fresh -p 43319` 起来后 `curl -s localhost:43319/api/v1/ready`,预期看到 `{"status":"ready","state":"running","seed":"settled"}`。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **`GET /api/v1/ready` reports the boot seed.** The one owner of `/ready` is `HttpDispatcher`'s registered `/ready` domain (mounted by `createDispatcherPlugin`); no second route is added. Both 200 bodies (all-healthy, and the #13408 degraded-secondary one) gain `seed` when a seed pipeline is registered on the host kernel:
  - `pending` while the `seed-settlement` tally has a source in flight;
  - `settled` once nothing is in flight and every outcome recorded in `seed-summary` is clean;
  - `failed` once nothing is in flight and a recorded outcome rejected a record, dropped a reference from a written row, or installed no rows. That is the same verdict the `objectstack:seed-settled` IPC message calls `ok: false` (`composeSeedSettledMessage`), so the HTTP reading and the IPC message cannot disagree.
  - A multi-tenant or `skipSeedData` boot suppresses its source on purpose and reads `settled`: no boot-time write is coming, so a waiter must not hang (the IPC message's own rule: it keys on `inFlight`, never `pending`).
  - No seed pipeline: no `seed` key, so the body is byte-identical to before (the #31601 `withClusterReading` precedent). The status code never depends on the reading; the booting / shutting-down / primary-down 503 envelopes are untouched.
  - The reading is taken per probe (`readSeedReadiness`, new `packages/runtime/src/seed-readiness.ts`), never memoized: it is two in-memory reads, no I/O.
- **`os serve` keeps the banner's promise.** When the banner printed `⚠ Seeds:   pending` and "seeding continues in the background; its result prints after this banner", the settle now prints the result once, on stderr like every banner row, so no log level hides it: `Seeds:   settled — com.example.showcase 138 rows` (yellow `⚠ Seeds:   settled — … ⚠` when a source dropped records). `createSeedResultAfterBanner` (new `packages/cli/src/utils/seed-result-after-banner.ts`) holds the promise: the banner thunk notes the snapshot it printed, and `os serve` wraps the existing announcer's `announceSettled` so the one settle message it sends also reports the result, printed only when that snapshot was in flight. A seed that settled before the banner keeps its banner row and prints nothing more. The runtime's `[Seeder] … complete` lines stay at `info`: a completed seed is not a degradation, and the level-immune print is the banner's channel.
- Docs: `content/docs/protocol/kernel/lifecycle.mdx` and `content/docs/deployment/self-hosting.mdx` describe the `seed` entry. Changeset: `@objectstack/runtime` and `@objectstack/cli`, patch.

## Tests

- `packages/runtime/src/http-dispatcher.ready.test.ts`, new top-level describe (the shared `/ready` harness file): the seed services are written by their real producers (`declareSeedSource`, `recordSeedOutcome`) on a fake host kernel whose `getService` throws on an unregistered name, like `ObjectKernel`'s. Pins: no pipeline ⇒ old body with no key; in flight ⇒ `pending`, then `settled` on the same dispatcher after the settle (not cached); one of two sources settled ⇒ still `pending`; rejected / dropped reference / empty install ⇒ `failed`, still 200; settled without an outcome ⇒ `settled`; both suppression reasons ⇒ `settled`; degraded-secondary body carries `seed`; booting 503 carries none.
- `packages/cli/src/utils/seed-result-after-banner.test.ts` (new; the helper's own file, so its tests do not load `serve.ts`'s plugin graph, which `check:test-source-alias` would otherwise ask eleven module-top imports for): banner said pending ⇒ the settle prints once across two settles; banner already settled ⇒ no print; no pipeline ⇒ no print; a throwing print is swallowed; and a comment-masked source pin that `os serve` composes it (the banner thunk notes its snapshot, and the announcer's `announceSettled` reports the result before the IPC send). A helper nobody calls would keep every other case green.
- `packages/cli/src/utils/format.seed-pending.test.ts`, new top-level describe: `printSeedResultAfterBanner` prints one line for a clean seed, one marked line for a seed with drops, and says `no rows reported` for an empty summary.

## Acceptance notes

- **Live window not reproduced in this container.** Booting `dev:showcase` and `dev:crm` with `OS_INLINE_SEED_BUDGET_MS=1` on fresh databases, the seed overran its budget (`[Seeder] Inline seed exceeded 1ms budget`, and the security seed claim logged `seedInFlight: 1`), but it settled before the HTTP listener answered and before the banner printed, so the first `/ready` reading was already `seed: "settled"`. The `pending` leg is therefore pinned by the unit tests above and by the ablation below, not by a live reading; the live run proves the reading reaches the real composed kernel's tracker (otherwise the key would be absent).
- **The clean-seed predicate now has a fourth spelling.** `composeSeedSettledMessage` (cli), `seedOutcomeIsClean` (runtime, this PR), `packages/verify/src/seed-outcome.ts` and the banner's `anyProblem` each state "no rejected record, no dropped reference, no empty install". They agree today; `@objectstack/cli` could import the runtime one. Noted, not filed: no defect.

## Verification

All readings below are on this branch, repository `objectstack-ai/objectstack`; the final head is `7350d54ff` (merge of `origin/main` at `199e36244` included) unless a line names another.

<details><summary>Package tests and typecheck</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime test` at `fe23e30a` (no runtime file changed after it): `Test Files 598 passed (598)`, `Tests 10665 passed | 19 skipped (10684)`, exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit` at `7350d54ff`: `Test Files 418 passed (418)`, `Tests 5959 passed (5959)`, lock `VERDICT command-exit 0`. The `integration` tier is left to CI: no integration file, `bin/` or `test/helpers/serve-process.ts` changed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck` (both include `check:test-typecheck` over the test layer): exit 0 at `fe23e30a`; cli again at `7350d54ff`, exit 0, `3 file(s) / 28 error(s) / 6 pinned signature(s)` held, unchanged.
- Targeted at `7350d54ff`: `seed-result-after-banner.test.ts`, `format.seed-pending.test.ts`, `serve-bound-port-publication.test.ts`: `Tests 62 passed (62)`.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (one per changed behaviour, each restored and proven by blob hash)</summary>

- Runtime: `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` replaced `withSeedReading({ status: 'ready', state }, readSeedReadiness(host))` with `withSeedReading({ status: 'ready', state }, undefined)` in `http-dispatcher.ts` (anchor 1 to 0, blob `db37e78f2193` to `bef5d9a6aed2`): `Tests 8 failed | 44 passed (52)`, every failure in the new #33233 describe; the degraded-secondary case stayed green because that branch has its own call. Restored: blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- CLI: replaced `promised = !!snapshot && snapshot.inFlight > 0;` with `promised = false;` in `seed-result-after-banner.ts` (blob `bab17c5c2a86` to `69d7108826cb`): `Tests 1 failed | 4 passed (5)`, the over-budget case. Restored: blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- Both test files import the source under test by relative path, so no `dist/` rebuild was needed for either leg.

</details>

<details><summary>Live boot</summary>

`OS_INLINE_SEED_BUDGET_MS=1 pnpm dev:showcase -- --fresh -p 43319`, polling `GET /api/v1/ready` once a second: the first answer was `{"success":true,"data":{"status":"ready","state":"running","seed":"settled"}}`. The seed overran its 1 ms budget (`[Seeder] Inline seed exceeded 1ms budget for com.example.showcase`), but settled before the listener answered and before the banner printed (`Seeds:   com.example.showcase 138 rows`), so no `pending` reading and no after-banner line was observable in this container; see Acceptance notes. `dev:crm` the same way: `seed: "settled"`, `Seeds:   com.example.crm 28 rows`. Both servers were stopped by the PIDs on their ports.

</details>

<details><summary>Derived gate families (local)</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 103 families at `7350d54ff`; all 103 ran there, each exit 0, captured before any pipe. `--ran` reconciliation: `103 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 103 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 103 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)`. `node scripts/check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` first exited 3 (its pinned fixture commit `621a4876` was outside this shallow clone); after fetching that one commit it exited 0. `pnpm check:test-source-alias` is the family that moved the after-banner helper out of `serve.ts`: on the first layout it asked `serve-bound-port-publication.test.ts` for eleven module-top imports; on this head it exits 0. Repo-wide CI families (`pnpm lint`, `test:repo`, the dogfood shards) are CI's and were not run locally.

</details>
